title: "A hook, not a label"

  allies: "Partner organisations that support the action (p. 39)"
  audience: "Who reads this, what they already know"
  format: campfire          # a scrolly is linear by nature; sweat-lodge material goes in the Backup section
  speaker: "Name · Organisation"   # goes in the narrative's first block or the end, not on the hook
  sources: []               # results files hand-typed numbers must trace to (check_numbers.R)
  constants: []             # definitional numbers (cutoffs, reference lines), not results
format:
  closeread-html:
    theme: [default, carpe-scrolly.scss]
    css: carpe-fonts.css
    embed-resources: true
    remove-header-space: true
    toc: false
    cr-section:
      layout: overlay-right    # type registers top-left, so the narrative card sits right; sidebar-right never covers the frame
---

```{r}
#| include: false
# Carpe helpers: carpe_fig() inserts charts with their word count; facts/numbers come from results.
carpe <- Sys.getenv("CARPE_SKILL", "~/.claude/skills/carpe-audience")
source(file.path(carpe, "assets", "theme_carpe.R"))
source(file.path(carpe, "assets", "carpe_numbers.R"))
# source("facts.R")   # one carpe_pull() per number; then write numbers as `r n(f$x, "pct")`
```

<!--
  Carpe Audience scrolly template (Keyes 2011 + closeread). Copy this file, carpe-scrolly.scss,
  carpe-fonts.css and fonts/ into talks/<name>/, then once:  quarto add qmd-lab/closeread --no-prompt
  A STICKY is a slide: a fenced div with an id starting cr- and the class .carpe-slide plus one layout
  class (.big .medium .quote .power .chart .blank .carpe-title, or a photo with style="background-image:url(...)"
  and .has-bg plus .left-third/.right-third/.left-half/.right-half/.right/.split). It keeps the slide
  rules: seven words, no bullets, one picture. The NARRATIVE is the story: the paragraphs that would
  have been the notes, written for a reader. Each block names its sticky with focus-on. One
  .cr-section per Story, with the story name as the chapter heading between sections. The first
  sticky is a hook, the last is the call to action or a callback (pp. 27, 39, 45).
  Press p in the browser: presentation mode hides the narrative and the arrow keys step the stickies.
  Audit: Rscript "$CARPE_SKILL/assets/audit_scrolly.R" <page>.html
-->

## Hook

::: {.cr-section}

::: {#cr-s01 .carpe-slide .has-bg .left-third style="background-image:url('images/placeholder.png'); background-position:70% 50%"}
Words in the dark third
:::

::: {focus-on="cr-s01"}
The first block earns the scroll: a question or a surprise, not the title and the speaker's name.
Say what the page is about and what the reader will be able to do at the end of it.
:::

:::

## Findings

::: {.cr-section}

::: {#cr-s02 .carpe-slide .big}
20%
:::

::: {focus-on="cr-s02"}
BIG: one number. The narrative says the sentence it belongs to, then a human example, then the
number again (p. 67).
:::

::: {#cr-s03 .carpe-slide .medium}
Only one cause stands out
:::

::: {focus-on="cr-s03"}
MEDIUM: a claim of seven words or fewer. The narrative carries the evidence.
:::

::: {#cr-s04 .carpe-slide .chart}
`r carpe_fig("images/placeholder_chart.png")`
:::

::: {focus-on="cr-s04"}
CHART: one point per chart (theme_carpe() + save_slide_fig()). Would one number do instead (p. 79)?
A series of frames on identical axes becomes consecutive stickies, one block each: the scrolly form
of motion.
:::

::: {#cr-s05 .carpe-slide .power}
::: {.items}
[First]{.off} [Second]{.off} [Third]{.off} [Fourth]{.off}
:::
:::

::: {focus-on="cr-s05"}
POWER LIST, highlight-the-fact (p. 67): the group with nothing lit, then one sticky per item.
:::

::: {#cr-s06 .carpe-slide .power}
::: {.items}
[First]{.on} [Second]{.off} [Third]{.off} [Fourth]{.off}
:::

[00%]{.stat}
:::

::: {focus-on="cr-s06"}
Statistic, then a human example, then the statistic again.
:::

::: {#cr-s07 .carpe-slide .quote}
> A quote may run longer. The reader stops here.
:::

::: {focus-on="cr-s07"}
QUOTE: the one layout allowed past seven words (p. 100). Keep the narrative short under it.
:::

::: {#cr-s08 .carpe-slide .blank}
:::

::: {focus-on="cr-s08"}
BLANK: a black frame for a deliberate pause before the turn (p. 59).
:::

:::

## Close

::: {.cr-section}

::: {#cr-s09 .carpe-slide .medium}
One thing to do Monday
:::

::: {focus-on="cr-s09"}
Close on the call to action, never "In summary" and never a bare "Questions?" (p. 45). A callback
to the opening also works (p. 27). Name the allies who support the action, and say where to start.
:::

:::
